This data set contains the twenty-two (22) point cloud files of the Blume Residence. The data was collected between January and March, 2020, in partnership with the Historic Resources Management Branch and the School of Construction, Southern Albertan Institute of Technology (SAIT). The Leica BLK 360, GeoSLAM ZEB Revo, and Leica C10 were used to collect hundreds of scans, which were registered in Leica Cyclone V.9.3.
